mapper.select: SELECT mr.id AS medical_record_id, mr.appointment_id, mr.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department, mr.diagnosis, mr.treatment, a.status, mr.create_time, ( SELECT MIN(p.id) FROM prescription p WHERE p.medical_record_id = mr.id ) AS prescription_id, ( SELECT MIN(e.id) FROM examination e WHERE e.medical_record_id = mr.id ) AS examination_id FROM medical_record mr INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = mr.appointment_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE mr.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY mr.create_time DESC, mr.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
